item.title: Chrome AI Features Wasting Much Bandwidth
item.content:encoded: 🔎 Finally solved the mystery. At some point this year (around a few months ago), my bandwidth/data usage went thru the roof. Figured out it was Chrome’s recent AI features. Then got immediate bandwidth-relief after disabling all the “AI innovations” and “On-device” stuff. Here is a screenshot of the settings: Find the Chrome AI settings under “AI innovations” I simply disabled everything on that settings page, and the needless bandwidth leakage stopped immediately. item.title: Launching My Latest WordPress Plugin: REST Pro Tools
